faqs.a1: Yes. The link detects the device and sends iPhone users to App Store, Android users to Google Play and desktop users to your fallback URL.

items.question: What exactly does Link My App do?
items.answer: Link My App creates one link for your app. When someone opens it, it detects iPhone, Android or another device and sends the user to the right destination.

items.question: Can I create multiple links for the same app?
items.answer: Yes. You can create different links for campaigns, locations or channels and see where clicks come from.

items.question: Does it generate a QR code too?
items.answer: Yes. Each download link can generate a QR code for posters, packaging, counters, events or physical campaigns.

items.question: What happens if the user opens it from a computer?
items.answer: Then Link My App uses the fallback link you define, such as a download landing page, info page or website.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
items.answer: No. Paste the App Store link, the Google Play link, choose the name you want and create your download link.

dashboard.createHelpIntro: A smartlink is one URL that automatically decides where to send each person based on the device they use.
createHelpSteps: Enter your app name so you can recognize it in the dashboard.
Paste the App Store link: it will be used when someone opens the link from iPhone or iPad.
Paste the Google Play link: it will be used when someone opens the link from Android.
Add a fallback link for desktop, undetected tablets, or other devices.
Choose the short link name and share it; the QR code will be generated automatically.
When you share the link or QR, Android opens Google Play, iPhone opens the App Store, and any other device opens the fallback link.

dashboard.estimateNotice: Estimate based on average industry conversion data. We analyze the geographic origin, device, and temporal patterns of each click to offer a realistic projection of the expected installation volume.
dashboard.estimateDetailsText: These are estimated downloads, not SDK-verified installs. We calculate an integer using average conversion rates: App Store 22%, Google Play 24%, and desktop or other devices 1%. The analysis can use signals such as IP, country, time, click source and repeat visits to make the estimate more realistic when that data is available.

qr.benefit1Title: Send each phone to the right store
qr.benefit1Text: One QR detects whether the phone is iPhone or Android and sends it directly to App Store or Google Play.
qr.benefit2Text: The QR is tied to a stable URL. Use it on posters, packaging, flyers, events or screens without creating a new one every month.
qr.benefit3Text: The QR is attached to a smart link, so you can see how many scans you had and how many reached App Store or Google Play.

qr.step1Text: App Store, Google Play and a fallback URL for desktop. One form, no code.
qr.step2Text: We automatically create the QR attached to your smart link. It detects the device and sends every click to the right destination.
qr.step3Text: Download the QR in high resolution. Print it on posters, packaging, counters or use it on screens.

qr.useCase1: QR for retail and ecommerce apps
qr.useCase1Text: Print the QR on boxes, packaging or counters so customers download your app.
qr.useCase2Text: Use the QR in stories, merchandise and meetups to drive social traffic to your app.
qr.useCase3: QR for SaaS and B2B apps
qr.useCase3Text: Share the QR in demos, trade shows or sales materials without needing two links.
qr.useCase4: QR for gyms and fitness apps
qr.useCase4Text: Place the QR at reception, locker rooms or screens so members download your app.
qr.useCase5: QR for restaurants and hospitality apps
qr.useCase5Text: Place the QR on tables, menus or receipts to download your ordering or loyalty app.
qr.useCase6Text: Centralize client app distribution with a measurable QR that separates channels.
qr.faq1Q: Do I need two different QR codes?
qr.faq1A: No. With Link My App you generate one QR that decides at scan time whether the user is on iPhone, Android or desktop and sends them to the correct destination.
qr.faq2Q: What resolution is the QR downloaded in?
qr.faq2A: We generate a high-resolution PNG so you can print it on posters, packaging, banners or flyers without losing quality.
qr.faq3Q: Can I change where the QR points without reprinting?
qr.faq3A: Yes. The QR is tied to a stable smart link, so you can change the destination or fallback link whenever you want. The printed URL stays the same.
qr.faq4Q: Can I count QR scans separately?
qr.faq4A: Yes. Each scan is counted as a click with source "QR" and appears separately from Instagram, web or email traffic.
qr.faq5Q: Does it work if my app is only in one store?
qr.faq5A: Yes. If you only have App Store or only Google Play, the QR can send users to your single store or to a fallback URL for the rest.
qr.faq6Q: How much does it cost to create my app QR?
qr.faq6A: Creating your app QR is free and it has no expiry date. You can generate QR codes for different campaigns, posters, locations or partners.
